lastCompletedStory.title: Recycle watcher module and cam orch-recycle-watch command

nextStoryContext: runOrchRecycleWatch (src/commands/orch-recycle-watch.ts) polls ORCH_RECYCLE_MARKER via readMarkerFn, reads ORCH_SESSION_MARKER fresh each poll via readSessionIdFn, resolves the orchestrator claude PID via resolvePidFn (pgrep -f <uuid>), sends SIGTERM via killFn, and removes the marker via removeMarkerFn (consume-once). All deps are injectable; handleOneTick is the extracted inner helper. Registered as case 'orch-recycle-watch' in index.ts (INTERNAL, near sidecar case ~line 1604). knip.json now includes 'pgrep' in ignoreBinaries. US-004 should wire cam run to spawn cam orch-recycle-watch as a detached background process alongside cam sidecar, and cam stop should SIGTERM and clean up the watcher process and its associated marker.
